clue.text: Reckoning to start like a person of noble status

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held 'Reckoning to start like a person of noble status (7)': A + COUNT gives only six letters and no clue word supplies the extra C; the clue reads as garbled or cut short and no source gives the printed text.
annotationWithheld.clue: Reckoning to start like a person of noble status

clue.text: A really quiet rest ensures calm

parts.note: PP, pianissimo, is the musical marking for very quiet
to rest is to take one's ease

explanation.surface: Taking a properly silent break guarantees peace of mind.
explanation.definitionFit: To pacify someone by meeting their demands is to soothe them into calm.

clue.text: Gloomy forecaster-accorded no credit

parts.note: the Trojan princess of Greek myth whose prophecies of doom were true but never believed

explanation.surface: A pessimistic weather presenter whom nobody takes seriously.
explanation.definitionFit: Apollo cursed the Trojan prophetess so her true warnings went unheeded, and her name now means any ignored prophet of disaster.

clue.text: For slapdash aunt to carry cash is inappropriate

indicators.note: to carry something is to hold it within, so one piece goes inside the other
slapdash work is careless and jumbled, so the letters of aunt are thrown into a new order

parts.note: P, a penny, stands for a small sum of cash

explanation.surface: It is unwise for a careless aunt to walk around holding money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'slapdash' scrambles AUNT to UNAT, and 'to carry' puts P inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Unapt is an old word for unsuitable or ill-fitted.

clue.text: Those individuals holding gold as a speculation

indicators.note: holding means one word keeps the other gripped inside it

parts.note: they means those people
OR is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: Some people buying gold as an investment gamble.
explanation.definitionFit: A hypothesis is a speculation, an idea put forward but not proven.

clue.text: Scouts desired change

indicators.note: change tells us the letters of desired are to be altered into another order

explanation.surface: Boy Scouts wanted things done differently.
explanation.definitionFit: To scout an idea is to reject it with scorn, which is to mock it.

clue.text: No work no tax to pay!

definitions.text: No work no tax to pay!

parts.words: No work no tax to pay!
parts.note: reads as a holiday with no job to do, but means goods exempt from customs charges

explanation.surface: A cheerful cry about a day off with nothing owed to the taxman.
explanation.walkthrough: Duty can mean work one must do or a tax on goods, and the clue plays on both.
explanation.definitionFit: Airport shops sell goods free of excise charges, so no levy is paid on them.

clue.text: Having reserve to think to remain unanswered

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held 'Having reserve to think to remain unanswered (9)': RES + PONDER is clear, but 'to remain unanswered' means the opposite of the answer; a word such as 'not' appears to be missing and no source gives the printed text.
annotationWithheld.clue: Having reserve to think to remain unanswered

clue.text: The German taken round the American centre gets a towel

indicators.note: taken round means one piece is wrapped around the other

parts.note: DER is the German word for the

indicators.note: the centre of a word is its middle letters

explanation.surface: A German man is shown round a US facility and handed something to dry off with.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The American' reads as a person, but only the word American is used, for its central letters; a towel counts as a drier because it dries you.
explanation.definitionFit: A towel is something that dries you, so it is one kind of drier.

clue.text: Advise returning a little blue-tit's egg usually

indicators.note: returning says the hidden letters are read backwards
a little says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Recommending that a bird's egg be put back where it came from.
explanation.walkthrough: The run TSEGGUS sits inside 'blue-tit's egg usually' and reads backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: To advise is to put forward a recommendation or idea.

clue.text: Spend a long time making the crossing

parts.note: to pass time is to spend it
an age is a very long time

explanation.surface: Taking ages over a journey across the water.
explanation.definitionFit: A sea voyage from one port to another is a crossing.

clue.text: The heartless cause distress -—- so trying

indicators.note: heartless means the word loses its middle letter

parts.note: to sting is to hurt or upset

explanation.surface: Unkind people upset others, which is hard to bear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartless' takes the H out of the middle of THE, leaving TE.
explanation.definitionFit: Something trying puts one's patience to the test.

clue.text: Having to do with food, as it is to be expected

definitions.meaning: a dish served at a meal is a course, so this is a matter concerning one
a phrase for anything natural or routine

explanation.surface: Thinking about dinner is quite normal.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally a concern with one dish of a meal; idiomatically something routine and naturally expected.

clue.text: Finish an outstanding feature and win

parts.note: an end is a finish
an ear literally sticks out from the head

explanation.surface: Ending with a striking flourish secures victory.
explanation.definitionFit: To win someone over is to make oneself dear to them.

clue.text: There's nothing dull in a swell perfume!

indicators.note: in places the first pieces inside the following ones

parts.note: to rise is to swell, as dough does
O looks like zero, nothing
mat, or matt, means dull, not shiny

explanation.surface: A big wave of scent with nothing flat about it.
explanation.definitionFit: To scent something is to perfume it with a pleasant fragrance.

clue.text: Study only when fit again

parts.note: to read a subject is to study it at university
just means only, merely

explanation.surface: Someone may only resume studies once back in good health.
explanation.definitionFit: To adapt or adjust once more is to make something suitable a second time.

clue.text: Sort of clue women may well find distasteful

indicators.note: sort here is a verb, to rearrange, so the letters of the next words are reordered

explanation.surface: Female solvers might dislike a certain kind of crossword clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unwanted or unpleasant is not received gladly.

clue.text: Most disgusting drink is served in the snuggery

indicators.note: served in means one piece is placed within the other

parts.note: a nest is a snug cosy place
Asti is an Italian sparkling wine

explanation.surface: Something truly foul being poured in the cosy back bar.
explanation.walkthrough: A snuggery is also a small cosy room in a British pub.
explanation.definitionFit: The superlative of nasty means the most foul or repellent.

clue.text: Stop restraining a boy for a certain period

indicators.note: restraining means holding in, so one piece is kept within the other

parts.note: to seal is to stop up
a son is a boy

explanation.surface: A command to halt while holding a child back for a while.
explanation.definitionFit: Seasonal work lasts only for part of the year, a limited time.

clue.text: States small page being accepted by school is questionable

indicators.note: being accepted by means placed inside the next piece

parts.note: a school of thought is a sect
US is the United States
p is the abbreviation for page

explanation.surface: A minor US page is admitted to a school, which seems dubious.
explanation.definitionFit: Something suspect is doubtful and open to challenge.

clue.text: Exults about lots and lots of people appearing

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece goes round the other

parts.note: to crow is to exult boastfully
D is the Roman numeral 500, a large number

explanation.surface: Gloating when a big crowd turns up.
explanation.definitionFit: Throngs are large gatherings of people.

clue.text: Old musical instrument — maybe given as present

indicators.note: maybe suggests the word that follows is just one possible arrangement of its letters

explanation.surface: An antique instrument perhaps handed over as a gift.
explanation.definitionFit: A snake-shaped wooden bass wind instrument used in church bands before the tuba.

clue.text: Be a sheepish creature and subject to attack

parts.note: taken as written
a tup is a ram, a male sheep

explanation.surface: Advice to be a timid ram and to put up with being set upon.
explanation.definitionFit: To assault someone violently is to give them a beating.

clue.text: Possibly hint a lad is sober but an adventurous character

indicators.note: possibly indicates the letters could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: Suggesting a young man is teetotal yet daring.
explanation.definitionFit: The seafarer of the Arabian Nights who made seven voyages of adventure.

clue.text: Deliver article up in deep depression

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: to rid is to free or deliver
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Handing over a piece of writing while in very low spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: The lowest point, as of fortune or mood.

clue.text: Confused tot left with a key

parts.note: to tot up is to add
E is a musical key

explanation.surface: A toddler with a key gets muddled.
explanation.definitionFit: Addle as an adjective means muddled, as in addle-headed.

clue.text: Come to a shrewd conclusion?

parts.note: split as finishing up clever, an end that is sagacious

explanation.surface: Reaching a sensible decision.
explanation.walkthrough: The adverb means end-on or lengthwise; the clue splits it into its parts.
explanation.definitionFit: Read as end plus wise, an ending that shows sense.

clue.text: Maybe leap to defence, initially, of this young creature

indicators.note: maybe says the letters given may be rearranged
initially picks the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A small animal might jump to protect itself.
explanation.definitionFit: The larva of a frog or toad, a young amphibian.

clue.text: The shortest fashion setters

indicators.note: fashion as a verb means to shape, so the letters are reformed

explanation.surface: Crossword compilers who write the briefest clues.
explanation.definitionFit: Most brief or curt in expression.

clue.text: Check before opening

parts.note: pre- is a prefix meaning before
a vent is an opening

explanation.surface: Inspecting something prior to its launch.
explanation.definitionFit: To check something is to stop it happening.
